title: vpc-audit-telemetry-module: Terraform module for CloudTrail -> OpenSearch shipping + retention
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Provide a reusable Terraform module that provisions audit logging and search for Private (VPC) deployments. The module will centralize CloudTrail configuration, an encrypted S3 landing bucket with lifecycle/retention rules, an OpenSearch (ELK-compatible) delivery pipeline, index lifecycle policies, and snapshot retention. It must support cross-account delivery (customer-managed logging account), KMS encryption, and a configurable retention policy (default 90 days) with an option to archive to S3 snapshots. The module should be idempotent, support rolling upgrades, and include health checks and CloudWatch metrics/dashboards.

Scope:
- CloudTrail trail(s) with multi-region option and S3 + CloudWatch Logs destinations.
- Encrypted S3 bucket with strict ACLs, lifecycle rules (transition to IA, expire), and bucket policies for log delivery.
- KMS key with key policy allowing Redwood control plane and customer's logging account.
- OpenSearch domain (single-tenant or shared) with instance sizing variables, automated snapshots to S3, and index lifecycle management (ILM) templates.
- Log ingestion: subscription filters / Kinesis Firehose or Lambda transformer to parse CloudTrail events and ship to OpenSearch.
- Retention configuration: index retention (days), snapshot cadence, S3 archive TTL.
- IAM roles and least-privilege policies for delivery and ingestion components.
- CI: Terraform validate/plan in PRs, acceptance test harness for a small synthetic log stream, and a Canary index to validate parsing.

Non-goals: full observability UI changes, long-term data analytics pipelines (these are follow-ups).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Module variables documented and defaults set; 2) CloudTrail created and delivering to encrypted S3; 3) OpenSearch index receives synthetic CloudTrail events and ILM moves indices per retention; 4) Snapshot to S3 runs at night and can restore a test index; 5) Health alarms for failed Kinesis/Firehose deliveries, OpenSearch cluster status yellow/red, and missing snapshots; 6) Terraform module has clear upgrade notes and non-breaking defaults; 7) Security review signoff and example usage in Private deployment blueprint.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Ava Martinez: Created ticket after architecture spike. Initial design attached in Confluence. MVP retention default set to 90 days to balance cost and compliance. Identified requirement to support cross-account logging for customer-managed logging accounts.

2026-03-11 - Rajiv Singh (Security): Security review requested - please include KMS key rotation strategy and an explicit deny for any public ACL on the S3 bucket. Also include an allowlist for IPs that can query OpenSearch endpoints when deployed in shared mode.

2026-03-11 - Liam Chen: Acknowledged. Will add KMS rotation doc and bucket policy template. Planning to use Firehose with Lambda transform for JSON enrichment so we can map CloudTrail event fields to typed OpenSearch mappings.

2026-03-12 - Design Review (Maya Patel, PM): Confirmed project alignment with Private Deployments. Asked that the module expose toggles for: (a) manage_opensearch boolean, (b) send_to_opensearch boolean, and (c) external_snapshot_bucket for customers who want long-term archival.

2026-03-12 - Engineering note (Liam Chen): Prototype terraform module in branch feature/vpc-telemetry-ENG-9021. Implemented S3 + CloudTrail + Firehose with minimal transformation. Findings: Firehose requires extra IAM for PutRecord and role chaining in cross-account scenarios. OpenSearch test cluster spun up in sandbox account and ingest validated with 1k synthetic events.

2026-03-12 - QA (Sofia Alvarez): Added acceptance test plan: a Jenkins job that runs terraform apply in a short-lived sandbox, sends 500 synthetic CloudTrail events, validates indices, triggers ILM rollover, and then tears down resources. Flaky test observed when OpenSearch instance type t3.medium.search under memory pressure; recommend default to r5.large.search for production.

2026-03-13 - Liam Chen: Opened PR #214 with module code and README. Marked PR WIP until security and cost review complete. Next steps: add index templates, durable snapshot lifecycle, and CloudWatch dashboards for cluster and ingestion health.

2026-03-13 - Product (Maya Patel): Please ensure the module's default settings are conservative for cost but have explicit variables so customers can scale. Add a recipe in the Private deployment quickstart for 'Minimal cost' vs 'Compliance-heavy' presets.
